ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: I chose Willet because the query is a benign math problem with no harm-adjacent content, so the only differentiator is raw capability. Willet's benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) and internal eval scores are clearly higher than Curlew's, and the gaps exceed the stated variance threshold. Since serving cost, latency, and context window are identical across the fleet, there's no reason to prefer the weaker model.
